notes.generated: Disposable build output. Rebuild with 0RebuildAssets.cmd or python tools/build_assets.py.
notes.alignment: Color, bump and specular images are the same dimensions and share exact region coordinates.
notes.packing: Deterministic MaxRects-style pack; smallest power-of-two texture that fits source regions; no 4096x4096 assumption.
notes.material_maps: Broad alpha/luminance-derived height plus material-class specular response, derived from v4.13 large-scenery treatment.

material_v2.normal_roughness_channels: RGB encoded XYZ normal, A roughness
material_v2.height_material_channels: R authored pseudo-world Z / 64, G intra-object material AO, B metalness, A emissive/auxiliary
material_v2.height_contract: worldZ = localShapeHeight * heightScaleWorld + heightBiasWorld; runtime rendered-scale factor is shared by depth/shadow consumers
